jei.simple_automation.info.controller: Place the controller inside a zone marked by two Border Markers, or up to 2 blocks around it. Build a copper golem in the zone or bring one on a lead to hire it, then right-click the golem with the tool it needs; sneak-right-click it with an empty hand to set it free. What the golems produce goes into the chests touching the controller, and the zone pauses when they are full. Right-click the controller to see the zone and its golems.
jei.simple_automation.info.quarry_contro: Golems dig the zone layer by layer, down to bedrock. Pickaxes mine stone and ores, shovels and bare hands dig dirt, sand and gravel. Cobblestone is placed under the golems over caves, lava and water, and lava is sealed.
jei.simple_automation.info.lumber_contro: Golems holding an axe fell whole trees in the zone at once, leaves included: their saplings, sticks and apples go straight to the chests. Each tree is replanted with its own species, 2x2 trees (dark oak, pale oak, big spruce and jungle) with 4 saplings. If the right sapling is still missing after a minute, another species is planted. Mangrove leaves give no propagules: put some in the chests and they are planted on the mud next to the roots.
jei.simple_automation.info.forge_control: Golems tend the furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces of the zone, with input and fuel from the chests, and store what comes out. Bare-handed they load them; with a shovel they stoke them so they cook faster, with the same fuel per item as vanilla.
jei.simple_automation.info.crusher_contr: Golems holding a pickaxe place the ore blocks from the chests on free spots of the zone and mine them. They get 50% more than mining the ore with the same pickaxe: Fortune counts, Silk Touch is ignored. Mine ores with Silk Touch in a quarry, then crush them with Fortune III.
jei.simple_automation.info.farm_controll: Golems harvest ripe crops bare-handed or with a hoe and replant them. They also sow seeds from the chests on empty farmland, and leave room next to pumpkin and melon stems for their fruit. A golem holding shears collects honeycombs from full beehives and bee nests (up to 12 blocks above the markers); with an empty glass bottle it fills honey bottles, taking the empty bottles from the chests. The bees stay calm.
jei.simple_automation.info.barn_controll: What a golem does depends on what it holds. Animal food: breeds the animals that eat it, up to a limit per species (babies included), with food taken from the chests. Shears: shears sheep, mooshrooms and other shearable animals. Bucket: milks cows, mooshrooms and goats, filling empty buckets taken from the chests. Brush: brushes armadillos for scutes. Sword, axe, mace or trident: culls the extra adults above the limit, never babies, named, leashed or tamed animals. Eggs, wool, meat and scutes lying in the zone go to the chests, and experience comes out as crystals. Fence the zone in so the animals stay inside.
jei.simple_automation.info.fishery_contr: Golems holding a fishing rod stand on the bank and fish in the still water of the zone, one water block each, within 5 blocks of the bank. They fish like a player: Luck of the Sea and Lure work, and treasure only bites in open water (at least 5×5 and 2 deep with air above). Each catch goes to the chests with 1 to 6 experience, stored as crystals, and wears the rod by one point.
jei.simple_automation.info.guard_control: Golems holding a sword, an axe, a mace or a trident strike the hostile mobs in the zone like a player: one hit per attack cooldown of the weapon, with its damage and enchantments (Sharpness, Smite, Fire Aspect, Knockback...). Each hit wears the weapon by one point. Kills count as player kills, so Looting works and rare drops can fall; the drops go to the chests and the experience comes out as crystals. Bosses, named or leashed mobs and the Warden (tag simple_automation:guard_blacklist) are left alone. Mobs only spawn near players, so the post works where you are.
jei.simple_automation.info.enchanter_con: Golems holding a book work at an enchanting table placed in the zone, with the power of the bookshelves around it (vanilla rules, up to 15). They always take the third option, the best one: the result is random, without choice, like for a player. Each enchanting costs 3 lapis lazuli from the chests plus the experience of 3 levels at the required level (at level 30: 97 + 102 + 107 = 306 experience, so 31 experience crystals), paid from the experience stored in the controller first, then with crystals from the chests; the change goes back to the controller. Warning: every unenchanted enchantable item and every book in the chests gets enchanted, one at a time.
jei.simple_automation.info.workshop_cont: Golems holding a Recipe Card work at the stations of the zone: crafting table, smithing table, stonecutter and brewing stand. Each golem takes the materials of its card from the chests (any item the recipe accepts, the card's own item first), uses the nearest station of its kind and puts the result and the leftovers (empty buckets...) back in the chests. At a brewing stand the real block brews (vanilla 20 seconds): the golem loads base potions, ingredient and blaze powder, then empties the finished potions; one golem per stand. Chain cards through the chests, for example "water to awkward potion" and "awkward potion to strength" on two golems. Anvil, grindstone and loom are not supported.
jei.simple_automation.info.border_marker: Place two markers at opposite corners of a rectangle to mark a work zone, then a job controller inside it. Zones cannot overlap. Right-click a marker to see which controller it belongs to.
jei.simple_automation.info.pipe: Moves items instantly between the containers it touches. A side facing a container inserts by default; switch it to extract with the Wrench and the pipe pulls items from that container into the other ones of the network, in turn. A pipe can also empty the buffer of a job controller.
jei.simple_automation.info.wrench: Right-click a pipe arm. Toward another pipe, it separates or joins them; toward a container, it cycles between insert, extract and disabled. Sneak-right-click breaks the pipe at once.
jei.simple_automation.info.filter: Right-click in the air to choose up to 9 items and switch between whitelist and blacklist; with JEI you can drag items from the list into the slots. Right-click a filled slot to cycle through the item's tags. Right-click a pipe arm facing a container to put the filter on it, and take it back with an empty hand.
jei.simple_automation.info.recipe_card: Right-click a crafting table, smithing table, stonecutter or brewing stand with a blank card to set it to that kind of station and open its interface. Place or drop (from JEI too) one item per slot: the card shows the result. At the stonecutter, click the result to pick another one. Right-click in the air to open the card again, sneak and right-click another station to change its station. Give the card to a golem of a Workshop Controller (right-click the golem).
jei.simple_automation.info.xp_crystal: The experience earned by golems (smelting, ores, animals, fishing…) never drops as orbs: the controller stores it and puts one crystal in its chests for every 10 points. Right-click to use one crystal, sneak and right-click to use the whole stack. The experience is released at your feet as orbs, so Mending repairs your gear as usual.
